doc: One rifle squad attacks two unarmed, killable squads that stand side by side 30 m away. Watch the playback: does fire pile onto the first victim until it dies, or spread over both (overkill: shots at a victim already dead that tick)? Explore only: no probes. Feeds the Prowess fire-distribution question (04, bead D2); gate probes (victims, overkill) come with that bead.
